faqs.q: Why do you ask me to match the board?
faqs.a: A level number can map to different layouts across versions or platforms.

faqs.q: Why are there no filler level pages?
faqs.a: Only verified, useful guides are published and included in discovery.
The content pipeline requires board, version, platform, source and verification date in the same generation task.
